title: Settings
subtitle: Make DocuRebuild yours. Everything is stored locally.

appearance.themeDescription: Choose light, dark, or follow your system setting.
appearance.accentDescription: Used for primary actions, selections, and highlights.
appearance.radiusDescription: Adjust how rounded panels and controls feel.
appearance.blurDescription: Transparency and blur on panels and dialogs.
appearance.densityDescription: Controls the height of toolbars and form fields.
appearance.fontSizeDescription: Only the application interface changes. Documents keep their own typography.
appearance.motionDescription: Reduce motion for comfort or accessibility.

language.title: Application language
language.description: Only the interface language changes. Your documents and OCR content are never translated.
language.burmeseNote: Burmese uses Unicode. Zawgyi text is preserved exactly as imported and is never converted automatically.

editor.description: Used for the document editor and future exports. Interface typography stays independent.
editor.preview: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. မြန်မာစာ စမ်းသပ်ချက်။
editor.fontsDescription: Import fonts for scientific text and keep them on this device. They are used by the editor and embedded in exports when licensing allows.

export.title: PDF layout
export.description: Choose the page size and margin for exported PDF files. The file is still created on this device.
export.pageSizeDescription: A4 is the default. Choose Letter for documents that use US paper.
export.marginDescription: Narrow fits more text on a page; wide leaves more white space.
export.note: These settings apply to PDF export only. Markdown, plain text and Word files keep their current format.

ocr.title: Local OCR engine
ocr.description: Tesseract extracts text on this device. Page images are never uploaded to an OCR service.
ocr.missingBurmese: Burmese (mya) language data is not installed. Install it before running Burmese OCR.
ocr.setupDescription: Install Tesseract and add the eng and mya traineddata files to its tessdata folder. If Tesseract is not on PATH, set DOCUREBUILD_TESSERACT_CMD to the executable.
ocr.privacy: OCR jobs run in a bounded local worker. Nothing is sent to a remote service, and no paid API is used.

unavailableReasons.not_found: Tesseract could not be found on this device.
unavailableReasons.not_executable: The configured Tesseract command cannot be run.
unavailableReasons.no_languages: Tesseract is installed, but no language data is available.
unavailableReasons.error: The OCR engine could not be checked.

ai.title: AI providers
ai.description: Connect your own AI providers. Keys are encrypted on this device and models are discovered with your credentials. AI output stays a proposal until you review it.
ai.migrationDescription: Your previous local AI settings are imported into a connection the first time this page loads. The old values are kept as a backup.
ai.connectionsDescription: Add one connection per provider account. Different connections can serve different tasks, and each can hold several keys.
ai.connectionsError: AI connections could not be loaded.
ai.noConnectionsDescription: Add a provider to enable text cleanup, region proposals, equation transcription and table reading.
ai.deleteConnectionConfirm: Delete this connection with its keys, models and task routes?
ai.testHint: A test only lists models with your saved key. It does not generate anything and is not counted in the request limit.
ai.retryAfter: The provider asked to wait {{seconds}} seconds. DocuRebuild does not retry on its own.

connectionErrors.ai_auth_failed: The provider refused the key. Check that the key is valid and can use this endpoint.
connectionErrors.ai_permission_denied: The key is not allowed to list models for this account.
connectionErrors.ai_rate_limited: The provider is rate limiting requests. Wait before testing again.
connectionErrors.ai_timeout: The provider did not answer in time.
connectionErrors.ai_unreachable: Nothing answered at this URL. Check the endpoint and your connection.
connectionErrors.ai_http_error: The provider returned an error. Check the endpoint and the provider status.
connectionErrors.ai_invalid_response: The provider returned a response DocuRebuild could not read.
connectionErrors.ai_invalid_url: That endpoint URL is not valid.
connectionErrors.ai_remote_not_allowed: Allow remote endpoints for this connection before contacting it.
connectionErrors.ai_base_url_required: Enter the endpoint URL for this provider.
connectionErrors.ai_endpoint_not_found: The endpoint was not found. Check the URL, including the API version path.
connectionErrors.ai_model_discovery_unsupported: This provider has no model list endpoint. Add a model ID manually.
connectionErrors.ai_provider_unavailable: The provider is not available right now.

ai.providerLocalHint: This provider runs on this device by default.
ai.providerRemoteHint: This provider is remote. Content you send leaves this device.
ai.name: Connection name
ai.baseUrlDescription: Leave empty to use the provider default. Remote endpoints must use HTTPS; HTTP is only allowed on this device.

costClassHints.local: Runs on this device. No provider charge.
costClassHints.free: A provider free tier. Its quota and availability are set by the provider and can change.
costClassHints.paid: Every AI action asks for approval before anything is sent.

ai.rotationDescription: How multiple keys are chosen. Cooling-down keys are skipped; a limit or quota error never falls back to an unauthenticated request.
ai.allowRemoteDescription: A remote provider receives the text or image you send. Nothing leaves this device until you allow it.
ai.enabledDescription: A disabled connection is never used, even when a task route points to it.
ai.maxAttemptsHint: How many keys or fallbacks may be tried before the request fails.
ai.connectionLimitHint: Rolling 24-hour cap for this connection. 0 means no limit.
ai.connectionBudgetHint: Verified spend cap for this connection. Blank means no cap.
ai.keysDescription: Add more than one key to rotate between them. Keys are encrypted and never shown again.
ai.apiKeyHint: The key is sent only to this provider and is never returned by the app.
ai.keyRequired: Add an API key to use this connection.
ai.noKeysNeeded: This provider does not require a key.
ai.modelsDescription: Models are discovered from the provider with your key. Favorite the ones you use most.
ai.noModels: No models discovered yet. Test the connection to load the model list.
ai.manualModelDescription: Use this when a provider serves models it does not list. Manual models are marked in the list.
ai.routesDescription: Choose the connection and model each task uses. A task without its own route uses the default route.
ai.routesNeedConnection: Add a connection before routing a task.
ai.defaultRouteDescription: Used by any task that has no route of its own.
ai.routeModelRequired: Choose a model for this route.

routeWarnings.vision_unsupported: This model does not report image input support. Verify it can read images.
routeWarnings.model_unavailable: The selected model is no longer listed by the provider.
routeWarnings.connection_unavailable: The selected connection is not ready.
routeWarnings.model_missing: Choose a model for this route.
routeWarnings.connection_required: Choose a connection for this route.
routeWarnings.model_not_in_catalog: The selected model is not in this connection's catalog.

ai.usageDescription: A local ledger records requests, reported tokens and verified costs. Document text is never stored.
ai.dailyLimitDescription: Rolling 24-hour cap across all providers. Connection tests are not counted. 0 means no limit.
ai.usageLimited: {{used}} of {{limit}} requests used in the last 24 hours.
ai.usageUnlimited: {{used}} request(s) in the last 24 hours. No limit is set.
ai.limitInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100,000.
ai.monthlyBudgetDescription: Caps verified spend recorded in the local ledger. Blank means no cap. Paid requests stop when the cap is reached.
ai.usageUnavailable: Local usage could not be loaded.
ai.usageHistoryDescription: Metadata only: provider, model, outcome and time. Document text, crops and replies are never recorded.
ai.usageHistoryEmpty: No AI requests in the last 24 hours.
ai.clearUsageConfirm: Delete the local AI usage ledger? This cannot be undone.
ai.privacy: Keys are stored in the encrypted local vault and are never returned by the API, written to logs or included in backups you upload. Content is sent only to the provider you route a task to. Every reply stays a proposal until you accept it.

history.title: AI usage history
history.description: Every AI request recorded on this device, newest first. Only metadata is stored — never document text, crops or model replies.
history.error: The local usage history could not be loaded.
history.empty: Adjust the filters or run an AI action to record a request.
history.privacy: This ledger is stored in the local database. It is not uploaded, synced to GitHub or shared.

backups.title: Backup copies
backups.description: Keep verified copies of each project on this device. Automatic copies are opt-in and run after you open a project or when the optional scheduled command runs.
backups.autoDescription: When enabled, opening a project creates a copy only if the newest one is older than the interval below. The optional scheduled command uses the same setting, interval and retention.
backups.autoLabel: Create automatic backup copies when one is due
backups.intervalDescription: How old the newest copy must be before opening the project creates another.
backups.keepDescription: Applies to automatic and manual copies. Creating another copy removes the oldest beyond this limit.
backups.privacy: Copies are written to the local data folder. They are not encrypted, uploaded or synced to GitHub. Automatic copies are a convenience, not a replacement for your own off-device backup.

storage.title: Local storage
storage.pathDescription: The application database, project folders, and immutable source files live here. Nothing is uploaded to a cloud service.
storage.offline: The storage location is unavailable while the local backend is offline.
storage.privacyNote: GitHub backs up source code and documentation only — never your documents or imported pages.

reset.title: Clear all data
reset.description: Factory reset permanently deletes every project, source file, database row, setting, AI key and backup copy stored by DocuRebuild on this device.
reset.dialogDescription: This returns DocuRebuild to its first-run state. The application stays installed.

items.projects: Every project, imported page, thumbnail and extracted figure
items.settings: Appearance, language, editor and backup preferences
items.keys: Saved AI provider connections and encrypted API keys
items.backups: Local backup copies, temporary files and the trash folder

reset.irreversible: There is no recovery from inside DocuRebuild. Download any backup you need before continuing.
reset.success: All local DocuRebuild data was cleared.

about.title: About DocuRebuild
about.principles: Built around local-first, free-first, accuracy-first principles.
